svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 16-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 12.6 s, bun check 38.3 s, tsgo 83.3 s. Peak memory: tsrs 12.6 GiB, bun check 15.2 GiB, tsgo 54.5 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 2.27 s, 1.79 GiB; bun check 4.63 s, 1.50 GiB; tsgo 10.97 s, 7.55 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.17 s, 0.25 GiB; bun check 0.34 s, 0.30 GiB; tsgo 0.93 s, 0.72 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.28 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.53 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.37 s, 1.19 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 1.05 s, 1.05 GiB; bun check 9.70 s, 5.23 GiB; tsgo 13.03 s, 7.63 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.07 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.12 s, 0.12 GiB; tsgo 0.30 s, 0.21 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.09 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.20 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.53 s, 0.24 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 1.11 s, 1.15 GiB; bun check 3.26 s, 0.92 GiB; tsgo 6.02 s, 4.39 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 1.14 s, 1.44 GiB; bun check 2.44 s, 1.33 GiB; tsgo 6.88 s, 5.81 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 1.32 s, 1.19 GiB; bun check 3.77 s, 0.89 GiB; tsgo 7.21 s, 4.85 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 1.57 s, 1.18 GiB; bun check 3.64 s, 1.04 GiB; tsgo 13.75 s, 6.60 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 1.69 s, 1.38 GiB; bun check 5.37 s, 0.74 GiB; tsgo 11.34 s, 6.88 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.46 s, 0.55 GiB; bun check 0.97 s, 0.50 GiB; tsgo 3.00 s, 1.75 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.34 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.70 s, 0.39 GiB; tsgo 1.72 s, 1.28 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.29 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.57 s, 0.45 GiB; tsgo 1.79 s, 1.39 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.26 s, 0.38 GiB; bun check 0.75 s, 0.41 GiB; tsgo 1.40 s, 1.13 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.23 s, 0.33 GiB; bun check 0.48 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.16 s, 1.08 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.30 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 0.85 s, 0.53 GiB; tsgo 1.92 s, 1.75 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-16 09:21 UTC; tsrs commit 4f27a79b9816d7d4d4bd1ed03136d712707ea9bb. TypeScript 7.0.2; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
